title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix $X$ is constructed from the features of the dataset. Each row corresponds to an observation, and each column corresponds to a feature.

title: Features in the Design Matrix
text: The features in the design matrix $X$ are 'length', 'likes', and $$'response_{time'}$$. The 'bot' column is the target variable.

title: Invertibility of $X**TX$
text: For $X**TX$ to be invertible, the columns of $X$ must be linearly independent.

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: Are the columns 'length', 'likes', and $$'response_{time'}$$ linearly independent?

title: Conclusion on Invertibility
text: If the columns are linearly independent, then $X**TX$ is invertible.
